reviews.review:
Actually quite a nice game, esp. if you like Dark souls, shooting, Sci-Fi. 
With some patches also quite stable ^^
Only just started playing but seems to be something of a challenge, as long as it is fair I'm willing to give it my best shot.

I find this to be a highly refreshing spin on the souls like genre. The game has a fun and highly addictive nature to it. Most of my favorite aspects of the dark souls series are included; as well as some elements unique to this title. Heres the pros and cons

pros: Beautiful environments (especially the dark forest in chapter 2) Progressive sound track. Challenging foes, especially the boss battles. Interesting character and weapon upgrade system. A story that is so deep and out there Im in love, this has me totally hoping for a sequel!! Combat system is so unique and flows well. Imagine primarily mage battles but with guns and swift dodge movements to evade. Its hard to describe but very well done in my opinion.

Cons/hopes for sequel(or dlc): No multiplayer:( I think coop boss fights and pvp would be matches (like actual death match and team battle areas) would make this game excel tremendously. Especially if bits could be earned during multiplayer.
Armor system is automatic, players have no choice in upgrade nor can we find cool sets to mix and match. adding in armor to discover and customize would improve rpg side of the game.
character customization: Although it is pretty sweet already, they could add to it for sure. Like more detail on facial features and body type.
Minor glitches/bugs: Main issue I saw was player getting stuck in environment a few times and movements were just gliding rather than walking animations lol. Luckily auto save is on point so I just go to menu and reload and its usually back to normal. Doesnt happen often.

overall the pros far outweigh the cons and I think any fan of hardcore rpgs, or 3rd person shooters should get this game without a doubt!

I adore this game. Odd because I find dark souls very meh. I have all base game acheivments so far and am working on the dlc before I finish off the cursed achievments. My current character in on ng++++ level 175.

The level design isnt bad but you can tell its an indie game when vompairing level design to dark souls. While the devs attempted to make it somewhat complicated, the level design feels much smoother though simplistic.

The enemy variation could be larger but the combat is what really shines to me. Its not even the slightest bit sluggish which I hated in darksouls. I started as a sniper and it felt soo right. 

I highly recommend people try this game though Id advise you avoid buying the dlc until you decide if the base game is for you as the dlc is absolute cancer and will only appeal if you enjoy the world and want the achievements.
I was looking for a game exactly like this. A single player story shooter and this game delivers. i started playing and didn't realize I was playing for as long as i had.

I have played dark souls and I have played Immortal and I like Immortal more. This game gives a sci fi twist on everything you have seen done over and over again. And if you are into WH40k this might be a favorite of yours too. The weapons and play style differences are fun and you can still die in a flash, but at least you know it is your fault. Darksouls will kill you just to be harder.

The world is vast and impressive. I have yet to see a game that uses this level of scale while not making it a slog to explore. Every time I find a new section I am interested to see what it looks like and brings.

My only complaint is that the enemies do suffer early RPG syndrome. Where they change their colors and some of the cosmetics rather than put a new enemy in.

So I give this a strong 9/10.
